sections.value: APPLICATION FOR EXEMPTION FROM REGISTRATION AS A NIGERIAN COMPANY PURSUANT TO SECTION __ COMPANIES AND ALLIED MATTERS ACT 20__

value:
e.g., We the above named foreign company, having been invited to Nigeria by the federal government, to carry out the manufacturing of gas in nigeria, for a period of six (6) months, are exempted from registering as a nigerian company.

e.g., Please find attached to this application, the necessary documents, as stipulated in section 80(2) of the companies and allied matters act 2020.

Thank you

Yours faithfully

e.g., 1. Particulars of Jaxson oil and gas inc. as the parent company outside Nigeria.

e.g., 2. Proposed name and place of business in Nigeria.

e.g., 3. Particulars of the name and address of each director, partners and principal officers of Jaxson oil and gas inc.

e.g., 4. Duration and proposed business of Jaxson oil and gas inc. in Nigeria.

etc.
